items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Pinky had left them and Crum had left them and a lot of, most of the original band had left except Frank and Dan LeBlanc and Frank Netto were the two original, two of the members from the original band.

ctx.x: Is that the guy that's in some kind of carnival business today where he does decorations? Was this the guy that came in after Earl Crum?
That was after Earl Crum, yeah.
